inspection: Opened the original 582x439 PNG with view_image personally before copying or editing a spec; image open 1 of at most 8.
facts: One shared graph, no subfigures: upward vertical sigma stress axis and rightward horizontal epsilon strain axis. The origin is printed as a slanted zero-shaped glyph below-left of the intersection. The approved text calls this origin O.

The curve runs from the origin through A, B, C, D, E, then stops at K. A is to the right of the steep near-straight initial branch; B is below-right of the transition; C and D are printed below the start and end of a near-horizontal plateau; E is above the maximum; K is to the right of the descending terminal endpoint.

OA rises steeply and approximately linearly. AB and BC rise, with B below the C-D plateau. CD is near-horizontal. DE rises to E, the highest point. EK bends down while moving right, ending at K distinctly above zero stress. There is no continuation beyond K or drop to the horizontal axis.

Three horizontal SOLID guides extend from the stress axis to A (lowest), B (middle), and E (highest). Their printed labels are sigma with Cyrillic-looking subscripts: bottom a single pi-like letter, middle a y-like letter, top a two-letter pr-like abbreviation. The same ordered roles become Prop., Elastic, Ultimate in English; these are not tick values.

Three vertical SOLID guides drop from A, E, and K to the horizontal axis. A's foot has a loop-and-descender q/Q-shaped label; K's foot has a p/P-shaped label. These retain the historical candidate's modern Q/P names. E's foot is unlabelled and lies between them. Horizontal foot order is origin, A/Q, E's unlabelled foot, K/P, rightward axis arrow and epsilon.
All axes, all curve segments, and all six guides are solid. Rough printing is not a dashed-line instruction; there is no intentional dashed segment.
No numerical ticks, tick intervals, grid, calibrated point coordinates, units, second curve, unloading line, or extra named point are printed. No caption is visible inside the cropped graph.
modernAdditionsNotSourceData: Clean screen-space coordinates and interpolation from the retained historical candidate remain unchanged; all displacement values are drawing-layout assertions, not measured stress or strain.

English axis and guide names, capital Q/P typography and O naming follow the retained candidate and approved prose. No claim of original glyph encoding is needed to preserve these unambiguous geometric roles.
Small point markers and the existing Schematic note are presentation choices, not newly supplied measurements.

The only visible change planned is Schematic anchor y=30 to y=25 in user space, a five-pixel downward move on the canvas to clear the retained O label. Source geometry, curve, guide endpoints, text content, and all 32px fonts remain untouched.

sourceAmbiguity.basis: Exact glyph case/encoding is recorded visually, not invented; origin naming is resolved by approved OA prose. Curve order, guide roles, solidity and endpoint order are clear. This is author observation only, not independent source approval.
